rules.requiredHint: Exclusive within the group: every image shows exactly one of these options.
rules.optionalHint: Exclusive within the group, but nothing may be picked (an implicit "none").
rules.multiHint: Options are not exclusive; every subset takes part in the combinations.
rules.fixedHint: Always visible and never combined, even when hidden in the PSD.
rules.restored: Restored the settings for this file
rules.restoredDetail: : {rules} groups, {constraints} rules, plus visibility and export settings.
rules.restoreNever: Do not restore automatically next time
rules.step3: Step 2: define how each group behaves.
rules.step3Detail: Clicking an option previews it instantly. Groups marked "combine" form the cartesian product; the others stay on the current option in every export.
rules.noFactors: No group takes part in the combinations yet
rules.nodeHint: Wire it like Blender nodes: groups → product × → export; drag a line for exclusions
rules.resetSelection: Back to the default option of every group
rules.clearAll: Delete every group (and the rules referring to them)
rules.violation: The previewed combination breaks a rule: {why}. It will not be exported.
rules.emptyHint: Tick layers on the Layers page, or use "⇢ children as options" on a layer folder. PSDs with [tags] in layer names get groups automatically.
rules.rebuildConfirm: Rebuild the groups from the [tags] in layer names? Current groups and exclusions are replaced.
rules.rename: Click to rename (used in export file names)
rules.deleteGroup: Delete this group (the layers stay untouched)
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete the group "{name}"? Exclusions referring to it are removed too.
rules.outProduct: Not combined: every export keeps the option selected below
rules.multiLimit: Multi-select enumerates the first {n} options ({subsets} subsets); the rest are ignored.
rules.optionNoLayers: This option has no layers yet; click ✎ to pick them
